name: InfraspecificRank
description: MUSIT CLASSIFICATION_TERM.INFRASPES_RANK → TAXON_CATHEGORY.TAX_CATH_ABBREV values used on botanical determinations.
source_query: SELECT DISTINCT tcat.tax_cath_abbrev FROM MUSIT_BOTANIKK_FELLES.classification_term ct JOIN MUSIT_BOTANIKK_FELLES.taxon_cathegory tcat ON tcat.tax_cath_id = ct.infraspes_rank WHERE tcat.tax_cath_abbrev IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tcat.tax_cath_id
